trigger: Police refuse to release me on bail
description: What to do if you are held at the station and refused bail.

steps.text: Stay calm and polite; do not argue or offer money.
Bail at the police station is free. Ask to be released on bail if you have not been charged to court.
If you are not tried within a reasonable time, you are entitled to release, on conditions if needed (s.35(4)).
Offer a trusted person as surety if the police ask for one.
Ask when you will be taken to court and note the time you were arrested.
Call your lawyer or Legal Aid to help secure your release.
Do not sign conditions you do not understand without your lawyer.
